description: This document describes version 2.0 of the core WebAssembly standard, a safe, portable, low-level code format designed for efficient execution and compact representation. WebAseembly Core is part of a collection of WebAssembly specifications: the Core WebAssembly Specification, the WebAssembly JS Interface, and the WebAssembly Web API.
title: WebAssembly Core Specification

description: This document provides an explicit JavaScript API for interacting with WebAssembly.
title: WebAssembly JavaScript Interface

description: This document describes the integration of WebAssembly with the broader web platform.
title: WebAssembly Web API
